findings.message: 4 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "YOUR WORKSPACE", "CHANNELS", "YOUR LIVING WORKSPACE", "MAKE A LITTLE PROGRESS").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "AKSARA A place for what’s next" 2.7:1 needs 4.5:1; "Foundation preview Local authority" 2.7:1 needs 4.5:1; "YOUR WORKSPACE" 2.9:1 needs 4.5:1; "PRIVATE" 2.9:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 3 panel shadow(s) heavy enough to read as floating: rgba(1, 5, 7, 0.18) 0px 6px 18px -12px | rgba(1, 5, 7, 0.18) 0px 6px 18px -12px | rgba(1, 5, 7, 0.18) 0px 6px 18px -12px
findings.fix: Panels sit on the ground: separate them with a fill one step from the ground or a quiet 1px border. A shadow, if any, is under 8% black with a small blur. Real overlays (menus, dialogs, popovers) may float.

findings.message: 5 icons sit in tinted squares or circles in 4 different colours.
findings.fix: This is the commonest tell of a generated dashboard. Drop the tinted square: a KPI is a label and a number; an icon, if it helps, is plain and in the text colour.

findings.message: 30 text blocks under 11px: Community workspace 10px, YOUR WORKSPACE 9px, PRIVATE 7px, CHANNELS 9px.
1 pair(s) of cards in one row end at different heights (by 77px).
findings.fix: Cards that share a row share a bottom edge: balance them by their content (the same number of rows, a block of similar height beside it), or stack them. In testing, ragged rows were marked down every time.

findings.message: The h1 is 29px ("A little clarity, Operator.").
findings.fix: An app screen is not a landing page: the title is 18-32px (20-24px on a phone).
